closure_claim: The current public evidence contains canonical native S4 observations and materially matched paper-level comparisons, but no route satisfies the full matched canonical-harness primary gate. Post-closure ARES review adds a canonical S4=C(P) mechanism with no admitted capability result; its GA/runtime reports measure computational cost rather than future capability improvement after adaptation.
reopen_when: a blocked provenance or common-membrane gate is resolved by new public primary evidence
a new public study exposes two or more independently canonical-linkable S4 systems under one benchmark/model/configuration cell
an adapter-preserved common execution membrane becomes publicly established for existing canonical systems
do_not_reopen_for: another benchmark-defined evolver without canonical-native linkage
method-name similarity without immutable implementation provenance
GA or runtime microperformance measurements without future capability improvement after adaptation
non_claim: This closure is not a claim that a matched S4 primary can never exist, not a zero capability result, and not a ranking. It freezes the reviewed current canonical/public-evidence state until materially new primary evidence changes a blocked gate.
